name: sway
label: SwayCommand
description: Hosts the SwayCommand cockpit (gesture VJ instrument for the Audima Labs Sway) as an embedded surface in theDAW's SWAY tab. Serves the static embed build at /sway-app; the same sources also ship as a standalone desktop app. Stage a build with 'npm run fetch:sway' in electron-ui/, or set theDAW_SWAY_DIST. Disable to hide the tab's embed and keep only theDAW's own Sway control plumbing.
